mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (member_id, order_date, order_status, total_price, delivery_addr) VALUES (#{memberId}, NOW(), #{orderStatus}, #{totalPrice}, #{deliveryAddr})
INSERT INTO item_order (order_id, item_id, order_price, count, selected_color, selected_size) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{orderPrice}, #{count}, #{selectedColor}, #{selectedSize})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id as orderId, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as orderDate, total_price as totalPrice, order_status as orderStatus, (SELECT item_name FROM item i JOIN item_order io ON i.item_id = io.item_id WHERE io.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1) as itemNm FROM orders o WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY order_date DESC

SELECT order_id as orderId, member_id as memberId, order_date as orderDate, order_status as orderStatus, total_price as totalPrice, delivery_addr as deliveryAddr FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT i.item_name as itemNm, oi.count, oi.order_price as orderPrice, ii.item_url as imgUrl, oi.selected_color as selectedColor, oi.selected_size as selectedSize FROM item_order oi JOIN item i ON oi.item_id = i.item_id JOIN item_img ii ON i.item_id = ii.item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND ii.is_main = 'Y'
